blocks.html: Descriptive statistics summarises the dataset in hand without claiming anything about a larger population; that claim is the job of inferential statistics (recall §1.2). It has two halves that travel together: central tendency (a typical, central value), built in this chapter, and dispersion (how spread out the values are around that centre), built in Chapter 3. This chapter builds the four means (§2.2), the median (§2.3) and the mode (§2.4), each for raw and for grouped data, and ends with how to choose among them (§2.5).
